awards.detail: 159.44–125.46 over Ag. A 33.98-point margin; Poland remains within the blast radius.

awards.detail: Lost 127.02–155.50 to The Oracle. Unbeaten confidence has been recalled by the manufacturer.

latest_roast.headline: The standings are merely an early draft.
latest_roast.body: A quarter of the season is gone. Maggie, Steph and Tiff are 3–1; The Oracle is 1–3 and currently listed beneath everyone with a working pulse. This is not a crisis. It is simply the league publishing a first draft so stupid that history will require extensive editing.
